messages:
incidents-bot: ALERT: p99 streaming latency spike detected for eu-dedicated-pool-42 · SLO breach (>3000ms) · auto-escalate to #incidents · thread opened by system

sara (oncall): saw this 30s ago, paging in. p95 ~ 800ms -> p99 ~ 3.6s on streaming endpoints. dashboards -> https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/streams/eu-pool-42?orgId=1

devon (eng-runtime): confirmed. tail latency for model x86-small jumps after queue depth > 450. autoscaler logs show scale-up started but new nodes not ready: `scale_event_id=ev-98321`

hao (eng-sre): looking at node provisioning. cloud provider returned: `InsufficientCapacity: Could not provision GPU-augmented nodes in eu-west-1a` around 1999001208. Fallback zone attempts still pending.

emily (support): CS reporting 3 customers with visible streaming stalls — one timed out client retry, others saw degraded progress bars. Ticket IDs: #12345, #12366, #12370. Evan on it.

evan (cs): reached out to the largest affected customer (acme-ai). They reported multi-second pauses mid-stream and partial outputs. Asking for ETA — want to avoid SLA credit.

devon (eng-runtime): heap of queued requests on pool-42: queue_depth=512, avg-queue-wait=1.8s. KV-cache hit rates normal. Problem is warmup latency for new workers (~7s for model weights) causing backlog amplification on bursts.

sara (oncall): immediate mitigations?

devon (eng-runtime): proposals:
- manual scale up to small-hotshot nodes in eu-west-1b (if capacity) `rctl pool scale --pool eu-pool-42 --add 6 --type hotshot-small`
- enable routing fallback to eu-secondary (lower perf but ready) for 20% of traffic: `routing:set policy=spill_to_eu-secondary rate=20%`
- temporarily relax p99 alerting to focus on mitigation (ops policy)

hao (eng-sre): trying manual scale now. running `cloudctl allocate --gpu-type a2-small --count 6 --zone eu-west-1b` — if this fails we'll trigger cross-region fallback.

ops-bot: ACTION_LOG created by sara: {"action":"manual-scale","actor":"sara","target":"eu-pool-42","requested_add":6}

devon (eng-runtime): also enabling request batching backpressure knob to reduce per-token contention: `runtime.config.set('batch.soft_limit', 12)` — this should cut effective throughput to let the backlog drain. Patching in 30s.

emily (support): posting interim note to affected customers: "We're aware of streaming stalls in EU, engineering running live mitigation. We'll update in 15 min or on resolution."

hao (eng-sre): cloud allocation succeeded for 3/6 nodes — other 3 failing with capacity error. New nodes booted and joined pool at 1999001282.

devon (eng-runtime): after new nodes joined: queue_depth -> 260, p95 -> 420ms, p99 -> 1.2s. Streaming stalls reduced but p99 still above 300ms SLO. Warmup tails still causing occasional spikes.

sara (oncall): good. keep routing fallback at 20%? might need 40% until warmup wave subsides. Thoughts?

devon (eng-runtime): increase to 35% for 10 minutes, then evaluate. Also enable fast-warmup flag for new instances (loads a trimmed checkpoint to reduce warmup from 7s -> 1.8s): `runtime.instance.hotstart=true` — requires canary approval from SRE.

hao (eng-sre): applied hotstart to the 3 new nodes; warmup time dropped to 1.7s for them. Rolling apply to remaining nodes underway.

evan (cs): Acme-AI updated — they see improvements, still occasional hiccups. They asked for a postmortem and root cause once stable.

emily (support): raising incident severity to P1 for external SLA tracking. Logging customer impact summary to #incidents-reports.

devon (eng-runtime): next steps for remediation and RCA tracking:
- Collect autoscaler timeline + cloud capacity errors (`scale_event_id=ev-98321`)
- Add margin to autoscaler to prefer warm spare machines (config `min_spares=2`)
- Improve cross-zone fallback speed (reduce handshake timeout from 12s -> 4s)
- Add targeted alert for queue_depth > 400 per-pool to detect early saturation
sara (oncall): assigning RCA to devon + hao. Evan/emily to coordinate customer comms. I'll keep this thread open and update every 10m until resolved.

ops-bot: PAGE sent to oncall rota: sara at 1999001236 — acknowledged at 1999001240

sara (oncall): update @channel: p99 now ~420ms, p95 ~360ms, queue depth 120. Scaling actions + routing bump to 35% reduced pressure. Leaving routing at 35% for 8 more minutes, then step down to 15%.

devon (eng-runtime): notes for post-incident:
- root cause: region capacity constraint + autoscaler conservative handshake + heavy burst pattern from customer onboarding causing warmup amplification
- mitigation worked: manual scale + hotstart + traffic spill to secondary
- short-term follow-ups: `min_spares` change, early queue depth alert, warmstart rollout to images

emily (support): customer impact log: 3 customers affected, highest severity = timeouts for 1 request pattern, estimated affected requests ~0.04% of EU traffic during incident window (1999001200-1999001350).

sara (oncall): closing actions: devon/hao create RFC for autoscaler tweaks and warmstart rollout. schedule 2h postmortem in #eng-runtime tomorrow 09:30 UTC. marking incident resolved in 10m if p99 < 350ms and queue<50.

ops-bot: INCIDENT_RESOLVED tentative at 1999001348 (monitoring window open)
